subject: economics
objective: What are the unemployment and participation rates?
instruction: Southfield compares the jobless with the jobholders: The labour force is 72,000, the number employed is 67,200 and the working-age population is 110,000. Unemployed = labour force - employed. Unemployment rate = unemployed / labour force. Participation rate = labour force / working-age population. Employment-population ratio = employed / working-age population. Required: unemployed, unemployment rate, unemployed to employed ratio, participation rate, employment population ratio.
